Render a parsed Rd topic as a Markdown string

Source: R/render_md.R
dot-render_topic_md.Rd

Produces the full contents of a single function's .md file, following the output format defined in CLAUDE.md (title line, arguments table, return value, collapsible examples, related functions, footer). Both the R code (comments, roxygen docs) and the rendered Markdown output are in English, per project convention.

Usage

.render_topic_md(topic, version, footer = TRUE)

Arguments

topic

A parsed topic list, as produced by .parse_rd_topic().

version

Version string of the documented package.

footer

Whether to append the "Generated by" footer with its relative links. Set to FALSE when concatenating many topics into _full_reference.md, where per-topic footers would repeat the same boilerplate dozens of times and the relative links don't resolve usefully anyway.

Value

A single Markdown string (the complete file contents).
